# knowledge review

=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "knowledge" "review"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Walk the inbox/ proposals oldest first and accept, edit, skip or delete each.
| Accept merges a proposal into its page. Then the README.md index is rewritten and the git commands for a pull
| request are printed; it never runs git.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew knowledge review [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --clone      Knowledge clone to review; defaults to the profile's ~/.dashcrew/knowledge/<name>.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)
